name: Scheduling Policy
description: Implement scheduling policies: round-robin, priority-based, capability-aware, affinity-based. Configurable per campaign.
purpose: Provide flexible, configurable scheduling strategies so different campaigns can optimize for their workload characteristics.
acceptanceCriteria: Round-robin scheduler distributes tasks evenly across eligible agents
Priority-based scheduler schedules higher-priority tasks before lower-priority ones
Capability-aware scheduler only dispatches to agents with matching capabilities
Affinity-based scheduler prefers agents that have previously handled related tasks
Scheduling policy is configurable per campaign
Policy can be switched at runtime without disrupting in-flight tasks
